scope.capability: experimental Campbell speed sweep and complex modal tracking for the bounded WP05 rotating_modal model
scope.model: linear straight collinear BEAM2 shaft with centered rigid axisymmetric disks
scope.execution: serial dense SciPy QEP at each explicitly provided spin speed
invariant_over_sweep: K, M, G and DOF reduction
rejected_scope: PETSc, SLEPc, sparse QEP, or MPI

responsibility_boundaries.rotating_modal: solve one validated model state at one signed speed; no branch identifiers
responsibility_boundaries.modal_tracking: phase-invariant association, degeneracy/subspace handling, branch lineage and explicit ambiguity; no physics solve
responsibility_boundaries.campbell: validate explicit sweep, invoke rotating_modal at each speed, orchestrate tracking and retain source result identities; no new physical formulation
responsibility_boundaries.post_campbell: render/export an existing CampbellResult only; must not assign/reassign branches or fill gaps

spin_speeds_rad_s.rpm_conversion: only through an explicit named RPM conversion helper

refinement.unresolved_ambiguity: preserve as AMBIGUOUS or UNTRACKED; never loop or force a connection

complex_mac.formula: abs(phi_i.conj().T @ M @ phi_j)**2 / ((phi_i.conj().T @ M @ phi_i).real * (phi_j.conj().T @ M @ phi_j).real)
complex_mac.mass: the common reduced physical mass matrix for the unchanged model over the sweep

polarization.transverse_basis: right-handed basis obtained by projecting the least-aligned global Cartesian basis vector into the plane normal to the validated rotation axis
polarization.stations: all BEAM2 shaft nodes with transverse amplitude >= 1e-8 times the maximum transverse amplitude in that mode
polarization.station_sign_conflict: INCONSISTENT; do not vote or average into a direction
polarization.relative_classification: FORWARD when sign(Omega)*chi > 0; BACKWARD when sign(Omega)*chi < 0; never classify at Omega=0

cost.undefined_polarization: omit polarization term and renormalize remaining weights to sum to one

assignment.algorithm: global one-to-one linear sum assignment (Hungarian algorithm) over an augmented matrix with explicit unmatched dummy nodes
assignment.stable_input_order: canonicalize mode descriptors by frequency, growth rate, polarization state and phase-invariant subspace signature; exact ties are represented as a cluster, not broken using LAPACK order
assignment.ambiguity_margin: second-best admissible candidate cost minus assigned admissible cost
assignment.below_margin: AMBIGUOUS; record all admissible candidates and do not commit an individual branch edge

degeneracy.mass_orthonormalization: Hermitian M-inner-product Gram whitening; reject rank-deficient or non-positive cluster Gram matrix
degeneracy.subspace_metric: singular values of Q_left.conj().T @ M @ Q_right (principal-angle cosines)
degeneracy.cluster_split: record parent cluster ID and explicit child branch lineage; use polarization only when defined, otherwise retain child assignment ambiguity

result_contract.type: CampbellResult, separate from ModalResult and RotatingModalResult
required_fields: source mode identifiers and source result keys/hashes
tracking scores, complex MAC and normalized frequency distances
result_contract.complex_values: explicit real/imag serialization; round-trip must preserve complex values
result_contract.stable_identity: branch IDs are created by tracking policy before plotting; plotting cannot alter IDs

plot_contract.ambiguities_and_gaps: show as gaps/markers; no interpolation across missing, ambiguous or untracked samples
plot_contract.authority: CampbellResult is authoritative; plotted coordinates are a projection only

one_x_line.intersection_interpretation: frequency coincidence / candidate critical-speed location within the linear modal model only

GYRO-05.purpose: independent analytical Campbell and invariant/ambiguity tests; not physical validation
required_assertions: zero-speed two-mode cluster is identified without individual eigenvector identity
cluster split has explicit parent-child lineage
analytical and computed branch frequencies agree within the frozen relative error
complex phase multiplication leaves tracking unchanged
controlled symmetric tie is reported AMBIGUOUS with candidates rather than forced continuity
all source QEP residuals satisfy the WP05 limit

controlled_ambiguity_fixture.current_modes: orthogonal real rotation of previous basis by pi/4, represented as complex vectors
controlled_ambiguity_fixture.expected: DEGENERATE_CLUSTER and individual MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES; AMBIGUITY_DETECTED=true; no individual edge committed

GYRO-06.purpose: internal mesh-convergence evidence for a flexible BEAM2 shaft and centered disk; not independent physical validation

fixture.geometry: straight 1.0 m collinear circular isotropic BEAM2 shaft, fixed at x=0, centered disk at x=1.0 m

metrics.relative_delta_definition: abs(f_32-f_16)/max(abs(f_32),abs(f_16),1 Hz) for each retained tracked branch at each speed

GYRO-06.interpretation: internal convergence evidence only; no independent physical validation or general rotor-dynamics qualification
